nodes.community_name: Deterministic Code Owns Anything That Must Be True
nodes.rationale: Alert when fell_back_rate > 0.05 over 1h, p95 latency_ms > 8000, sustained circuit_open_events > 0, or allergen_reject_rate > 0. LLM failures never fail generation; check validation.fellBack instead.

nodes.label: fallbackNarrative
nodes.community_name: Deterministic Code Owns Anything That Must Be True

nodes.label: Adaptive Check-in Engine
nodes.community_name: Deterministic Code Owns Anything That Must Be True
nodes.rationale: LLMs narrate this output; they never compute it. Explicit non-goal: no LLM-as-judge. EMA α=0.25 then least-squares slope; damped ±200 kcal adjustment.

nodes.label: Deterministic Code Owns Anything That Must Be True
nodes.community_name: Deterministic Code Owns Anything That Must Be True
nodes.norm_label: deterministic code owns anything that must be true
nodes.rationale: Unifying thesis: let deterministic code own anything that must be true; let the model only produce things a human will review; make every AI artifact versioned, measured, and reversible.

nodes.label: Incident to Eval Gate
nodes.community_name: Deterministic Code Owns Anything That Must Be True
nodes.rationale: Every coach-reported bad meal name or prep note becomes a de-identified golden NarrativeInput fixture before close; assert fallbackNarrative + runGuardrails still pass. Never copy client PII. Close only after CI green on @gymos/ai tests.

nodes.label: OTP_PEPPER
nodes.rationale: Server-only secret mixed into SHA-256(code + ':' + pepper) before storage; rotating it invalidates outstanding codes. Locally a fixed non-production pepper is used when unset.

nodes.label: OTP TTL and Lock
nodes.rationale: Coach accounts exist only after email OTP confirm. Codes are hashed with a pepper, expire in 10 minutes, and lock after 5 failed attempts. Duplicate email or phone is a conflict, not a second user. Production refuses to start without OTP_PEPPER.

nodes.label: Production Mail Fail-Closed Boot
nodes.rationale: Never send from resend.dev (testing domain delivers only to the account owner). Boot fails closed if RESEND_API_KEY is set with EMAIL_FROM on resend.dev, or in production if RESEND_API_KEY, OTP_PEPPER, or EMAIL_FROM is missing. SMS OTP is intentionally out of scope for the pilot.

nodes.label: Machine-Checkable Acceptance
nodes.rationale: Write or update a spec before generating code. Specs describe current implemented behavior; product changes update spec, code, and tests in the same PR. Proven by tests cited at the bottom; a bullet with no test is a gap, not an invitation to invent HTTP status codes.

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Narrative Guardrails
nodes.rationale: schema, numeric_claim, shape_mismatch, and ungrounded checks fail closed to fallbackNarrative so generation never fails solely because the LLM failed.

nodes.label: No LLM-as-Judge Scorer
nodes.rationale: Agent evals reuse merge gates plus harness bans instead of an LLM judge, matching the nutrition engine's distrust of ungrounded model grading.

nodes.label: ALLERGEN_POSTCHECK_FAILED
nodes.rationale: Safety signal treated as SEV-1: SQL hard filter and independent post-check disagreed. Any REJECTED in 24h is SEV-1 until explained; fix food allergen_tags vs profile codes and add a regression test before re-enabling generation.

nodes.label: Constrained JSON Schema Decoding
nodes.rationale: response_format json_schema strict means the server will not generate numeric fields; there is no field to put a macro number in.

nodes.label: Four Fail-Closed Guardrails
nodes.rationale: schema (name + prepNotes only), numeric_claim regex, shape_mismatch, ungrounded catalog foods. Guardrail rejection is content failure and does not trip the circuit breaker. Defense in depth: constrained decoding AND Zod parse AND content linting.

nodes.label: Allergen Dual-Check
nodes.rationale: Severe allergies are data, not UI-only warnings. Foods are hard-filtered by allergen tags before the solver (Layer 2). After composition, assertNoRestrictedFoods runs again. Neither check is delegated to the LLM.

nodes.label: Human-in-the-Loop Publish
nodes.rationale: Architectural, not a UI nicety: generation always produces DRAFT; publishing always requires explicit coach confirm; dietary profile changes flag a PUBLISHED plan NEEDS_REVIEW.

nodes.label: Generation Always Creates DRAFT
nodes.rationale: The LLM never writes kcal or macros. Item macros come from food_db or an audited coach_override. Generation must not fail solely because the LLM failed; fallbackNarrative still yields a DRAFT.

nodes.label: narrate Circuit Breaker
nodes.rationale: 3 consecutive failures open a 5-minute circuit and instant template fallback. A 4xx HTTP error aborts retries immediately.

nodes.label: Layer-3 Circuit Breaker
nodes.rationale: On circuit open, check llama.cpp health and restart the llm container; generation continues on templates until the breaker closes. Pilot assumes a single API instance and llama.cpp --parallel 1; raise concurrency only via pg-boss serialization.

nodes.label: llama.cpp LLM Service
nodes.rationale: Commented out until GGUF is provisioned (AI_MODE=local). Qwen3 4B Q4_K_M, --parallel 1, no outbound network access.

nodes.label: Layer 3 Language Model
nodes.rationale: Only job is meal name ≤60 chars and prepNotes ≤280 chars from de-identified {foodName, grams}. The LLM is an enhancement, never a dependency.

nodes.label: Email OTP Signup and Reset
nodes.rationale: Resend email OTP proves ownership for signup and forgot-password without paid SMS; codes are SHA-256+pepper hashed, single-use, 10-minute TTL.

nodes.label: Roadmap Phase 4 Coach Marketplace
nodes.rationale: Rescoped from seeded client login to coach-as-standalone-product: self-signup, portfolio, catalog, later client hire. Coach-is-the-tenant preserves JWT orgId/outletId.

nodes.label: Roadmap Phase 7 Payments
nodes.rationale: Payment rail is useless until Phase 4 portfolios and listed plans exist; prices stay display-only until then.

nodes.label: Coach Is the Tenant
nodes.rationale: Self-signup either provisions a new org/outlet/tenant_config with COACH+ORG_ADMIN or joins via join_code as COACH only, so every JWT still carries a real orgId/outletId.

nodes.label: FR-C1 vs Public Coach Signup
nodes.rationale: PRD FR-C1 wants invite-only MFA auth; ADR-0006 shipped public coach self-signup. Audit will not reverse ADR-0006 without an explicit human go-ahead.

nodes.label: Lefthook Pre-commit Gitleaks
nodes.rationale: Local half of the security/quality gate; CI is the enforcing half. Pre-commit runs gitleaks, Prettier, and ESLint; pre-push scans git history with gitleaks.

nodes.label: image-size CVE Audit Ignores
nodes.rationale: GHSA-w3rx / GHSA-5p2g DoS via crafted ICNS/JXL/HEIF. No patched npm release yet (all versions ≤2.0.2 affected). Remove ignores when image-size / metro ships a fix.

nodes.label: nanoid 3.3.18 Override
nodes.rationale: CVE-2026-67213 / GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8: customAlphabet/customRandom infinite-loop DoS when size is 0. 3.3.17 is still flagged; 3.3.18 is patched.

nodes.label: FormKeyboardRoot
nodes.rationale: asForm (web preventDefault) is independent of avoidKeyboard; iOS KeyboardToolbar covers pads that have no return key.

nodes.label: useFocusChain Named Order
nodes.rationale: Mount-order auto-register is unsafe under Strict Mode and conditional height units; field order is an explicit names array, never mount order.

nodes.label: gymos-openapi MCP Server
nodes.rationale: Filesystem MCP scoped to packages/contracts/openapi so coding agents read the committed CI-verified spec instead of inventing endpoints. Read-only by construction.

nodes.label: Hand-Written Client DTOs
nodes.rationale: packages/contracts/src/types.ts stays hand-written because most OpenAPI responses are still anyObject (ADR-0007). Generating TS with hey-api or openapi-typescript would replace precise DTOs with unknown. Codegen is unblocked only after auth routes are on app.openapi, response bodies use real Zod schemas, and the generate→prettier→git diff gate is green. Until then OpenAPI is HTTP documentation plus drift surface, not the TS source of truth.

nodes.label: Prompt Canary
nodes.rationale: Land meal-narrative.v2.ts alongside v1, expose via promptCanaryPercent on the tenant manifest, watch offline plus online metrics 24–72h, promote or flip back with no deploy.

nodes.label: Tenant aiConfig Manifest
nodes.rationale: Multi-tenancy is config plus data, never if (tenant === ...) code forks. resolveAiConfig merges env with tenant flags so one tenant can run Qwen while another runs fallback.

nodes.label: Alert Must Have a Runbook
nodes.rationale: An alarm without a documented response is noise that trains people to ignore alarms.

nodes.label: Nutrition and AI Safety Checklist
nodes.rationale: PRs that touch nutrition, Layer-3, or meal-plan flows must keep kcal/macros in Layers 1–2, keep plans DRAFT, de-identify Layer-3 payloads, and fail closed to fallbackNarrative.

nodes.label: Four-Layer Meal Plan Architecture
nodes.rationale: FR-C5 mandates physiology → solver → language model (names/notes only) → personalization, with hard floors and no macros from the model.

nodes.label: Hybrid AI Nutrition
nodes.rationale: Letting an LLM invent calories or macros is unsafe and unauditable; coaches still need readable names, prep notes, and a review workflow before anything is client-facing.

nodes.label: Layer 1 Physiology
nodes.rationale: Physiology plus goal to macro targets via Mifflin–St Jeor / Katch–McArdle with safety floors; pure code that never learns.

nodes.label: Layer 2 Deterministic Solver
nodes.rationale: Seeded, reproducible meal solver over the food catalog; hard-filters restrictions first; default week mode is daily_template.

nodes.label: Layer 3 Narrative LLM
nodes.rationale: Optional local LLM names meals and writes prep notes only; schema-constrained; never emits nutrition numbers; deterministic template fallback on any failure so generation never fails solely because the LLM failed.

nodes.label: Layer 4 Personalization
nodes.rationale: Coach feedback events steer Layer-2 rankScore; later eval-gated LoRA adapters for narrative style only, never medical authority.

nodes.label: Mandatory Human Review
nodes.rationale: Generation always creates DRAFT; client-facing publish requires explicit coach confirm; never auto-publish on generate or adjustment apply.

nodes.label: Local Development Stack
nodes.rationale: Mirrors production shape: Neon as local Postgres, R2 as MinIO; credentials are localhost placeholders only.

nodes.label: Ephemeral Queue Postgres
nodes.rationale: Deliberately separate and ephemeral with no volume, matching production where queue-db lives on the VM and holds no tenant data.

nodes.label: Pilot Architecture
nodes.rationale: Single-coach mobile-first web at $0/month: Turborepo, RN primitives on web, Neon Postgres, hybrid AI, Oracle VM or stripped PaaS fallback.

nodes.label: Coach-Only Product
nodes.rationale: Locked 2026-08-17: current implementation is coach-only and the client/member app does not exist yet, so Phase 4 is greenfield.

nodes.label: Phase 4 Client Member App
nodes.rationale: New member app, not a new architecture; reuses coach data/auth/module patterns. Blocked until P1 tokens are stable.

nodes.label: Phase 1 Re-skin
nodes.rationale: In scope only if reverting the change changes pixels: tokens, components, and presentational restyle with no fetch, routing, or business-conditional changes.

nodes.label: Phase 2 Directional Alignment
nodes.rationale: Small directional moves toward v4 without a rewrite and without touching more than one module's worth of code at a time.

nodes.label: WeaveLine Motif
nodes.rationale: Signature motif: two colored threads encoding relationship health, not raw progress; must not be simplified to a generic progress bar.

nodes.label: Security Policy
nodes.rationale: No secrets in the repo; gitleaks on pre-commit, pre-push, and CI; JWT on /v1 except public auth; LLM container has no network egress.

nodes.label: OpenAPI Completeness Gap
nodes.rationale: Auth routes missing from spec, responses mostly untyped, client types hand-maintained; fix before P4 because a client app will copy a stale client.

nodes.label: Gold Narrative JSONL Export
nodes.rationale: De-identified published day-1 names/notes; input is catalog foods+grams. Hash recorded on the model card. Never train on PII.

nodes.label: LoRA Narrative Adapter
nodes.rationale: Adapters improve meal names and prep style only. Macros stay in Layers 1-2. Rollback is an adapterVersion config flip with no DB migration.

nodes.label: Qwen3 Instruct GGUF
nodes.rationale: Intended use is coach-facing meal names and prep notes. Out of scope: kcal/macros, medical advice, unsupervised chat, inventing foods, auto-publish.

nodes.label: Adapter Version Canary
nodes.rationale: Same promote discipline as prompt canaries via featureFlags.adapterVersion or AI_ADAPTER_VERSION.

nodes.label: gymos-openapi MCP Server
nodes.rationale: Read-only filesystem MCP scoped to packages/contracts/openapi so coding agents query the committed spec instead of inventing routes.

nodes.label: Optional Local llama.cpp on VM
nodes.rationale: Qwen3 GGUF on the VM with AI_MODE=local; fallback naming keeps working if the model misbehaves.

nodes.label: promptVersion Canary
nodes.rationale: Minority promptVersion sampling via tenant manifest so narrative changes do not go 100% until offline evals and online KPIs hold. Rollback needs no code deploy if both modules remain packaged.

nodes.label: PaaS Worker-Stripped Tradeoff
nodes.rationale: Vercel+Render+Neon $0 path disables worker/pg-boss and forces AI_MODE=fallback so web+API can run without an Oracle VM.

nodes.label: Security and Tenancy Checklist
nodes.rationale: Auth, API, schema/RLS, and list-query changes require server-side authorization, no cross-tenant leakage, and no tenant-name conditionals.

nodes.label: Per-request Principal Resolution
nodes.rationale: resolvePrincipal(db, userId) replaces the process-global principal cache so concurrent users cannot share identity.

nodes.label: Postgres RLS
nodes.rationale: ENABLE without FORCE for the pilot because the table-owner connection bypasses RLS; FORCE lands when a dedicated non-owner API role exists.

nodes.label: Solito Cross-Platform Navigation
nodes.rationale: Solito owns Link, useRouter, and usePathname inside @gymos/app so the same screens navigate on web and native.

nodes.label: Alignment Prompt v5
nodes.rationale: CLAUDE.md alignment v5 is the audit target and wins on conflict with architecture v4; existing ADRs remain current-state decisions.

nodes.label: Org-Unbound RBAC / IDOR Gap
nodes.rationale: can() org-wide scope does not bind resource orgId; flagged fix-before-P3/P4 because retrofit cost grows with every new route and tenant.

nodes.label: Roadmap Phase 1 Backend Hardening
nodes.rationale: Auth, tenant scoping, RLS, and config registry must harden before new UI surfaces because mobile, client, and gym-admin all consume this layer.

nodes.label: JWT Refresh Sessions
nodes.rationale: The shared gymos_gate cookie and process-global getPilotPrincipal were correct for one coach and incorrect the moment a second concurrent user exists.

nodes.label: Shared-Schema Tenant Isolation
nodes.rationale: List queries did not filter by tenant scope and several client-scoped tables lacked outlet_id; a second organization would have leaked data.

nodes.label: Tenant Config Registry
nodes.rationale: A process-global loadManifest(path) cache is correct for one gym and incorrect the moment a second organization needs different cuisine, quota, or brand colors.

nodes.label: Never Fork Per Customer
nodes.rationale: Tenant differences must be config or data, never if (tenant === ...) conditionals, because per-customer forks do not scale.

nodes.label: Expo Router Native Shell
nodes.rationale: apps/mobile is an Expo Router SDK 57 native-only shell that mirrors apps/web coach routes so shared packages/app screens are reused rather than forked. Expo web is out of scope; coach web stays Next.js.

nodes.label: Platform Splits in @gymos/platform
nodes.rationale: .native versus default web splits cover storage, theme, desktop breakpoint, safe-area, and PDF share so feature screens stay platform-agnostic.

nodes.label: Alignment P1 Re-skin
nodes.rationale: P1 extends Tamagui tokens to exact v5 values and adds Weave/DualRings/canvas tint with zero logic, routing, or signup changes.

nodes.community_name: ADR-0015 Meal AI Planner Portion Realism

nodes.label: Named Pace Intensity
nodes.community_name: ADR-0015 Meal AI Planner Portion Realism
nodes.rationale: Gentle/Standard/Aggressive remain creatable at the fastest safe rate; tenant weeklyDeltaKg is desired intent only and is clamped, never displayed as an unsafe daily target.

nodes.label: COACH_OVERRIDE_KCAL_MIN 800
nodes.community_name: ADR-0015 Meal AI Planner Portion Realism
nodes.rationale: Hard minimum of 800 kcal so the slider cannot emit a 70 kcal target; stored target_kcal is source of truth for meal-plan generate.

nodes.label: D2 Coach Meal Instructions
nodes.community_name: ADR-0015 Meal AI Planner Portion Realism
nodes.rationale: Versioned coach_meal_instructions table, sanitized at save, appended last onto MEAL_NARRATIVE_SYSTEM. Coach authority is narration only; portions and macros stay engine-owned.

nodes.label: D3 Per-Meal Regenerate
nodes.community_name: ADR-0015 Meal AI Planner Portion Realism
nodes.rationale: Blocked on D1 solveMeal extraction. Regenerates one slot with a fresh sub-seed and logs REGENERATE_MEAL rather than solving the whole week and discarding the rest.

nodes.label: D4 Per-Meal Kcal Split
nodes.community_name: ADR-0015 Meal AI Planner Portion Realism
nodes.rationale: Presentational derived sum next to each meal section header; no new fetch or contract. Makes D3 regenerate actionable.

nodes.label: D5 Rotating Template Week Mode
nodes.community_name: ADR-0015 Meal AI Planner Portion Realism
nodes.rationale: Full 7-day independent solve maximizes variety but wrecks grocery/prep practicality. Default N=3 rotating templates; daily_template remains default so onboarded tenants do not silently change.

nodes.label: D6 PREFERRED Restriction Type
nodes.community_name: ADR-0015 Meal AI Planner Portion Realism
nodes.rationale: Positive preference reuses dietary_restrictions as preferred:<foodId> with a rank boost that never bypasses SQL allergen hard-filters. Also fixes food_rankings slot-folding via Math.max.

nodes.label: foods.maxUnits Ceiling
nodes.community_name: ADR-0015 Meal AI Planner Portion Realism

nodes.label: solveMeal Extraction
nodes.community_name: ADR-0015 Meal AI Planner Portion Realism
nodes.rationale: DRY: one portion-solving implementation consumed by solveDay and D3 regenerate so the two paths cannot drift.

nodes.label: assertNoRestrictedFoods Swap Gate
nodes.community_name: ADR-0015 Meal AI Planner Portion Realism
nodes.rationale: Second independent Layer-2 check on DRAFT swaps; LLM is not involved. generate still hard-filters via candidatesForRestrictions.

nodes.community_name: ADR-0015 Meal AI Planner Portion Realism

nodes.label: ADR-0014 Coach Calorie Override
nodes.community_name: ADR-0015 Meal AI Planner Portion Realism

nodes.community_name: ADR-0015 Meal AI Planner Portion Realism
nodes.norm_label: adr-0015 meal ai planner portion realism

nodes.label: Eval Task Dietary Swap Postcheck
nodes.community_name: ADR-0015 Meal AI Planner Portion Realism

nodes.label: Clamp-Then-Derive Calories
nodes.community_name: ADR-0015 Meal AI Planner Portion Realism
nodes.rationale: Fixed kg/week cannot be the calorie formula because Aggressive -2 kg/week is VLCD-territory and incompatible with a 25% TDEE cap. Pace is an intensity name; kcal is clamped; kg/week and ETA are derived outputs.

nodes.label: Warn Don't Block Calorie Override
nodes.community_name: ADR-0015 Meal AI Planner Portion Realism
nodes.rationale: Named ticks stay clamped per ADR-0008. Explicit coach targetKcal warns past recommended intensity and sex floors but still creates the client, because blocking forced coaches to accept a clamped number they did not choose.

nodes.label: D1 Per-Food Serving Ceilings
nodes.community_name: ADR-0015 Meal AI Planner Portion Realism
nodes.rationale: A global gram cap is too high for oils and too low for bulky staples. Chosen option E: per-food maxUnits plus deterministic pattern expansion when an item hits its ceiling, preserving seeded reproducibility and ADR-0001 Layer-3 numeric exclusion.

nodes.label: Layer 3 Narration-Only Boundary
nodes.community_name: ADR-0015 Meal AI Planner Portion Realism
nodes.rationale: ADR-0001 lineage: Layer 3 never emits or influences kcal/macro/portion numbers. D1 option D and LLM-driven variety/preference were rejected on that boundary.

nodes.label: Four-Layer Hybrid Nutrition
nodes.community_name: ADR-0015 Meal AI Planner Portion Realism
nodes.rationale: End-to-end LLM meal plans fail on safety, auditability, and reproducibility. Layers 1-2 own numbers, Layer 3 owns words, Layer 4 is the only learning layer, and a human must publish.

nodes.label: Hybrid AI Investable Thesis
nodes.community_name: ADR-0015 Meal AI Planner Portion Realism
nodes.rationale: Accepted tradeoff is operating solver plus LLM. Payoff is auditable nutrition, safe degradation, measurable narrative quality, and preference learning without turning weights into a medical authority.

nodes.label: CODEOWNERS Human Gate
nodes.rationale: Agents propose changes; they must not bypass required human review on packages/core, packages/ai, and infra/.

nodes.label: Phase 0 Discovery Audit
nodes.rationale: Mandatory blocking audit with zero code changes except CLAUDE.md and the audit ADR; Phase 0 blocks every later phase.

nodes.label: GymOS Coding Agent Contract
nodes.rationale: Execution contract for agents: one logical unit per PR, domain logic in packages/core or modules barrels, nutrition numbers only in Layers 1–2, and CLAUDE.md wins on product-alignment conflict.

nodes.label: GymOS Alignment Initiative
nodes.rationale: Brownfield alignment of the existing apps/ monorepo with architecture v4 and the design system in four phases, without a rewrite; this prompt wins on conflict with v4.

nodes.label: Neon Instant Restore
nodes.rationale: Preferred restore: branch from a point in time (6h window on free), repoint DATABASE_URL, redeploy. Drill quarterly and record time-to-restore.

nodes.label: Probes Must Hit /health/live Only
nodes.rationale: A DB-touching health probe or runaway poller burns CU-hours. Probes must hit /health/live only. Scale-to-zero cannot be disabled on free; idle connections must not stay pinned open.

nodes.label: Stateless Pet VM
nodes.rationale: The VM is a stateless pet: tenant data lives on Neon, media on R2. Rebuild from cloud-init in under 30 minutes with zero data loss. Oracle Always Free VM.Standard.A1.Flex, Ubuntu 24.04, fail2ban, 2G swap, UFW 22/80/443 only.

nodes.label: Stripped Worker PaaS Tradeoff
nodes.rationale: Web + API only on free tiers so the pilot can run without a VM. Nightly worker jobs and the local LLM are off. Render free spins down after ~15 min idle (first request 30–60s). AI_MODE=fallback only. Keep PILOT_DEPLOY_ENABLED (VM) false while on PaaS so the two paths do not fight.

nodes.label: Hybrid AI Nutrition System
nodes.rationale: Deterministic engine owns every calorie and macro number; a local self-hosted LLM may only write meal names and prep notes. Hallucinated calorie numbers are a safety issue, not a quality issue. ADR-0001.

nodes.label: Layer 1 Physiology
nodes.rationale: Never learns. Mifflin–St Jeor or Katch–McArdle BMR, TDEE, goal clamps. Clamp-then-derive (ADR-0008): displayed kg/week is always derived from the clamped number.

nodes.label: Layer 2 Deterministic Solver
nodes.rationale: Never learns except being steered by Layer 4 rankings. Candidate filtering happens in SQL before the solver. Seeded PRNG makes plans bit-identical and auditable.

nodes.label: Layer 4 Personalization Rankings
nodes.rationale: The only learning layer. Coach actions become ai_feedback_events; a nightly job aggregates Bayesian-smoothed food_rankings. No model weights change. Rankings cannot bypass SQL allergen filters.

nodes.label: Portion Realism
nodes.rationale: ADR-0015 D1: a global gram cap was absurd for olive oil and too small for rice. Fix is per-food maxUnits plus dynamic pattern expansion when an item hits its ceiling.

nodes.label: Seeded Plan Reproducibility
nodes.rationale: mulberry32 over a djb2 hash of the generation DB id. Same seed yields a bit-identical plan on every machine so generations are auditable and replayable.

nodes.label: Ephemeral queue-db
nodes.rationale: pg-boss state only, deliberately ephemeral with no tenant data and no backups (ADR-0008). Lives on the VM so the Neon free tier is never kept awake by polling.

nodes.label: DNS-01 via DuckDNS
nodes.rationale: Caddy obtains Let's Encrypt certs with DuckDNS TXT records; invalid DUCKDNS_TOKEN, DuckDNS API hiccups, and Let's Encrypt 5/week per-domain rate limits are the usual ACME failures.

nodes.label: Let's Encrypt Staging CA Debug
nodes.rationale: Always debug ACME against the staging CA because production Let's Encrypt rate-limits 5 issuances per week per domain.

nodes.label: Never Prune Docker Volumes Blindly
nodes.rationale: docker system prune must keep volumes because Caddy certificates and queue-db live on named volumes; log rotation is docker json-file 10MB×5 per service.
